text:
Nina Park: Quick sync  compact compare table tweaks. Two items: badge loading jumps & version pin behaviour in dense mode. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-compare
Sam Ortiz: pushed a compact mock. Pin sits close to the right-most badge and it looks cramped on small widths.
Zoe Kim: keyboard focus issue: tabbing skips the pin button in dense rows. We should ensure one predictable tab stop per row in compact mode.
Priya Singh: a11y: VoiceOver reads the badge as 'badge' only. Need aria-label like: 'Throughput 130 rps; P95 10 ms; meets SLO.' Keep visible tooltip concise.
Carlos Méndez: visual shift: badges arrive async and push the metric text. Propose reserving fixed width and showing a skeleton placeholder to avoid layout jump.
Asha Rao: inline "pinned" pill idea seems promising. Instead of expanding a new metadata row, show a small pill with a caret for details. Keeps row height stable.
Nina Park: can we make the pill non-focusable by default? open details via Enter on the row to keep keyboard flow simple.
Zoe Kim: agreed. If pill toggles content it must have aria-expanded and visible state. Otherwise keep it decorative (aria-hidden) and rely on row action.
Priya Singh: for screen readers, ensure the pinned state is announced (aria-pressed or aria-selected) and that focus returns to the row after closing details. I'll draft a brief checklist.
Sam Ortiz: I'll add CSS to reserve 84px for badges and add a skeleton. Also will increase the pin hit target to 32px.
Carlos Méndez: copy suggestion: tooltip visible -> 'P95 10ms  within SLO'; aria-label -> full sentence.
Asha Rao: QA: add a Percy snapshot with throttled network to catch badge jumps and a keyboard-only test for tab order.
Nina Park: timeline: Sam uploads Figma variants today, Zoe opens PR tomorrow, Priya runs a11y check after merge. Any objections to the short tooltip? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
